title: Hand Contract: Bones for the Choir
summary: The Bone Choir is buying, and the Hand is selling.

dialogue.intro: A note sealed with a golden hand: 'The Bone Choir wants bones. Lots of them. They pay the Hand; the Hand pays you.'
offer: 'Thirty-two bones. Don't ask what they sing with them.'
dialogue.reward: The sack of bones rattles away into the dark. The Hand pays.
dialogue.done: Somewhere, the Bone Choir is singing.
